legend: High-power view of endometrioid adenocarcinoma of cervix composed of well-formed glands, tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes, round open vesicular nuclei, and minimal mitoses or apoptotic bodies. HPV mRNA in situ hybridization and p16 were negative (not shown).

The tumour is composed of well formed glands, tumour infiltrating lymphocytes, round open vesicular nuclei and minimal mitoses or apoptotic bodies. HPV mRNA in situ hybridization and p16 were negative (not shown).
